questions: how do I apply for a passport

answers.sw: Unaweza kuanza ombi la pasipoti kwenye immigration.go.tz: chagua e-Services, kisha Online Passport Application na OMBI JIPYA. Jaza taarifa zako, ambatisha picha na vielelezo, kisha hakiki na thibitisha ombi. Fuata maelekezo ya malipo kwa control number, chapisha fomu na uiwasilishe pamoja na vielelezo kwenye Ofisi ya Uhamiaji husika.
answers.en: Start at immigration.go.tz: select e-Services, Online Passport Application, then New Application. Complete your details, attach your photograph and supporting documents, and check and confirm the application. Follow the control-number payment instructions, print the form and submit it with supporting documents to the relevant Immigration Office.

source.document: MWONGOZO WA HUDUMA YA PASIPOTI NA HATI ZA KUSAFIRIA.pdf

answers.sw: Andaa cheti chako cha kuzaliwa au cha tajnisi, cheti au kiapo cha kuzaliwa cha mmoja wa wazazi au cheti chake cha tajnisi, kitambulisho cha NIDA, nakala ya pasipoti ya mzazi kama anayo, na barua ya maombi. Utahitaji pia uthibitisho wa shughuli unazofanya au sababu ya safari yako. Vielelezo vya ziada vinaweza kuombwa kulingana na hali yako.
answers.en: Prepare your birth or naturalisation certificate, a parent's birth certificate or affidavit or naturalisation certificate, your NIDA identity card, a copy of a parent's passport if available, and an application letter. You also need evidence of your occupation or purpose of travel. Additional supporting documents may be requested for your circumstances.

source.document: MWONGOZO WA HUDUMA YA PASIPOTI NA HATI ZA KUSAFIRIA.pdf

answers.sw: Kuna Pasipoti ya Kawaida, Pasipoti ya Utumishi na Pasipoti ya Kidiplomasia. Pasipoti ya kawaida hutolewa kwa raia wa Tanzania kwa safari za nje ya nchi. Za utumishi na kidiplomasia hutolewa kwa wenye sifa zilizoainishwa kisheria.
answers.en: The three types are Ordinary, Service and Diplomatic passports. Ordinary passports are issued to Tanzanian citizens for international travel. Service and Diplomatic passports require the eligibility specified by law.

source.document: MWONGOZO WA HUDUMA YA PASIPOTI NA HATI ZA KUSAFIRIA.pdf

answers.sw: Toa taarifa polisi na kwa maandishi kwenye Ofisi ya Uhamiaji iliyo karibu nawe; ukiwa nje ya nchi, wasiliana na Ubalozi. Kwa ombi la pasipoti nyingine, mwongozo unaelekeza kutangaza upotevu kwenye magazeti mawili, moja la Kiswahili na moja la Kiingereza, kuandaa tamko la kisheria na kujaza ombi la pasipoti iliyopotea. Mazingira ya upotevu yatahakikiwa.
answers.en: Report the loss to the police and in writing to the nearest Immigration Office; if abroad, contact the embassy. For replacement, the supplied guidance requires notices in two newspapers, one in Kiswahili and one in English, a statutory declaration and an application for a lost passport. The circumstances of the loss will be assessed.

source.document: MWONGOZO WA HUDUMA YA PASIPOTI NA HATI ZA KUSAFIRIA.pdf

answers.sw: Jaza ombi la pasipoti nyingine mtandaoni. Andaa barua inayoeleza mazingira ya kuharibika kwa pasipoti, na uwasilishe pasipoti iliyoharibika wakati wa kuomba nyingine.
answers.en: Complete an online replacement application. Prepare a letter explaining how the passport was damaged and submit the damaged passport with your application.

source.document: MWONGOZO WA HUDUMA YA PASIPOTI NA HATI ZA KUSAFIRIA.pdf

answers.sw: Fungua ukurasa wa Online Passport Application kupitia e-Services kwenye immigration.go.tz, kisha chagua ANGALIA OMBI ili kufuatilia ombi ulilokamilisha. Kama bado hujakamilisha fomu, chagua ENDELEZA OMBI.
answers.en: Open Online Passport Application through e-Services at immigration.go.tz and select Check Application to follow a completed application. If your form is unfinished, select Continue Application.

answers.sw: Anza kwenye immigration.go.tz, chagua e-Services na e-Visa Application Form. Tumia email yako, hifadhi namba ya maombi, jaza fomu na ambatisha picha na nyaraka zinazohitajika kwa aina ya visa yako. Fuata maelekezo ya malipo na uwasilishe ombi. Unaomba visa kwa madhumuni gani ya safari?
answers.en: Start at immigration.go.tz, select e-Services and e-Visa Application Form. Use your email, keep your application number, complete the form and upload the photograph and documents required for your visa category. Follow the payment instructions and submit the application. What is the purpose of your visit?

answers.sw: Ingia kwenye mfumo wa maombi ya visa kwa kutumia namba yako ya maombi ili kuangalia maendeleo au kupakua Visa Grant Notice. Angalia pia email uliyotumia kwenye maombi kwa taarifa zinazotumwa kuhusu ombi lako.
answers.en: Use your application identification number on the visa application portal to check progress or download your Visa Grant Notice. Also check the email address you supplied in your application for updates.

questions: do I need another visa for Zanzibar

answers.sw: Ukitembelea Tanzania Bara na Zanzibar, chagua mahali utakapoanzia safari wakati wa kujaza fomu. Unaweza kutembelea sehemu zote mbili bila kuomba visa nyingine kwa sababu ya kuvuka kati ya Bara na Zanzibar.
answers.en: When visiting both Tanzania Mainland and Zanzibar, select your first destination in the application. You can visit both without obtaining a second visa solely for travelling between Mainland Tanzania and Zanzibar.

questions: does my child need a visa application

answers.sw: Kila mwenye pasipoti anatakiwa kuwasilisha ombi lake la visa. Hata mtoto aliyetajwa kwenye ombi la mzazi anatakiwa kuwa na ombi lake tofauti.
answers.en: Each passport holder needs a separate visa application. A child included in a parent's application still needs a separate application.

questions: can entry be refused with a visa

answers.sw: Visa Grant Notice haimaanishi kuingia nchini kunaruhusiwa moja kwa moja. Afisa Uhamiaji kwenye kituo cha kuingilia atakagua kama umetimiza masharti ya kuingia.
answers.en: A Visa Grant Notice does not guarantee entry. The Immigration Officer at the entry point checks whether you meet the entry requirements.

source.document: MWONGOZO WA HUDUMA YA PASIPOTI NA HATI ZA KUSAFIRIA.pdf

answers.sw: Lipa kwa control number uliyopewa kwenye ombi lako, ukizingatia aina na kiasi cha fedha kilichoainishwa. Malipo ya ndani yanaweza kufanywa kwa simu au benki. Usimkabidhi afisa fedha ili akulipie.
answers.en: Pay using the control number issued for your application and the specified currency and amount. Domestic payments can be made by mobile payment or bank. Do not hand cash to an officer to pay on your behalf.

answers.sw: Vibali vya kuishi vina makundi matatu: Class A kwa wageni waliojiajiri au wawekezaji, Class B kwa wageni walioajiriwa kwenye kampuni au taasisi binafsi, na Class C kwa makundi mengine kama watafiti, wastaafu, wamisionari na watu wa kujitolea. Unakuja kwa shughuli gani?
answers.en: Residence permits have three classes: Class A for self-employed foreigners or investors, Class B for expatriates employed by companies or private institutions, and Class C for other categories such as researchers, retirees, missionaries and volunteers. What activity will you be coming for?

questions: jinsi ya kuomba kibali cha kuishi
how to apply for a residence permit

answers.sw: Kama shughuli yako inahitaji Work Permit, anza maombi ya pamoja kupitia kazi.go.tz. Baada ya idhini ya Work Permit, fuata hatua za Residence Permit kwenye mfumo wa Uhamiaji. Kama huhitaji Work Permit, tumia Online Residence Permit Application kupitia e-Services kwenye immigration.go.tz, fungua akaunti, jaza fomu na ambatisha nyaraka zilizothibitishwa.
answers.en: If your activity requires a Work Permit, start the combined application through kazi.go.tz. After Work Permit approval, follow the Residence Permit steps in the Immigration system. If no Work Permit is required, use Online Residence Permit Application under e-Services at immigration.go.tz, create an account, complete the form and attach certified documents.

answers.sw: Ingia kwenye akaunti yako ya maombi. Submitted Application Status huonyesha hali ya ombi; Pending Application ni sehemu ya kuona na kujibu maombi ya taarifa au nyaraka zinazokosekana; Pending Payment huonyesha maelekezo ya malipo.
answers.en: Sign in to your application account. Submitted Application Status shows progress; Pending Application lets you view and respond to requests for missing information or documents; Pending Payment shows payment instructions.

questions: alama za vidole kibali cha kuishi

answers.sw: Baada ya malipo, utapokea Residence Permit Enrolment Notification. Fuata maelekezo yake ya kufika Ofisi ya Uhamiaji kwa kuchukuliwa alama za vidole na picha.
answers.en: After payment, you will receive a Residence Permit Enrolment Notification. Follow its instructions to attend an Immigration Office for fingerprints and a photograph.

answers.sw: Ukikosa taarifa au nyaraka kwenye ombi, utaarifiwa kupitia mfumo wa Residence Permit au email ya akaunti yako. Angalia Pending Application na jibu hoja au ambatisha nyaraka zilizoombwa ili ombi liendelee.
answers.en: If information or documents are missing, you will be notified through the Residence Permit system or your account email. Check Pending Application and respond to the query or provide the requested documents so processing can continue.

questions: kuomba kibali kabla ya kuingia Tanzania
apply residence permit before entering Tanzania

answers.sw: Maombi ya Residence Permit yanapaswa kuwasilishwa ukiwa nje ya Tanzania na kuidhinishwa kabla ya kuingia nchini. Kama tayari upo nchini na hali yako ni tofauti, wasiliana na Idara ya Uhamiaji kupitia info@immigration.go.tz kwa mwongozo wa kesi yako.
answers.en: Residence Permit applications should be submitted while you are outside Tanzania and approved before entry. If you are already in the country and your circumstances differ, contact info@immigration.go.tz for guidance on your case.
